en: Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a Central‑European town edge: a prominent, ornate neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance building with a steep gabled roof and decorative stepped gables stands in a tree‑filled park, accompanied by a smaller villa‑like house in front. Behind them are several multi‑storey buildings with similar steep roofs, and beyond that open fields laid out in long strips and a low rolling landscape. A wide unpaved tree‑lined road runs to the left. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
